input.summary: ["Roofs part built in parts/roofs.mjs: the eight buildings' main roofs via roof() (gable, hip, pyramid tower cap, barn gambrel, pavilion gable), keep boxes for the stacks, and hand-built porch sheds and the wagon lean-to; make.sh writes a whole build.nbt.", "Not done here: roof.json (runParts takes one spec for one building, so the part calls roof() per building; runParts prints 'roof: skipped'), trusses, the oven vault top and the tank lid (shell B's water_tank/bread_oven helpers own them), and the palette clean-up is partial.", "Residual OFF-PALETTE: oak_slab x34 (plot 1 default soffit), stripped_birch_log_stairs x10 (plot 4 verge), tuff/polished_deepslate x21 (plot 3 slate mix auto-mix), iron_bars x8 (barn preset bars); 157 writes refused into shell-owned air, which should clear once the real walls exist."]

waste.what: Ran make.sh repeatedly to find which roof blocks were off-palette, then located them by scanning build.nbt cell by cell with a throwaway script (/tmp/scan-roofs-part4.mjs).
waste.cost: about 6 full rebuilds and one scan script; each guess at a material swap was a retry
waste.tool: mcd roof --dry-run (or a roof-report option) that lists each off-palette block with its cell and the spec key that produced it (material auto-mix, soffit, verge, preset bars).

waste.what: Had to call roof() once per building because runParts reads one roof.json for the whole row, so the spec for eight buildings could not be a single roof.json.
waste.cost: about 20 hand-written roof calls with keep boxes and overhang objects written by hand
waste.tool: roof.json that accepts a list of buildings (each with footprint, style, y, keep), or runParts running one layRoof per building.

waste.what: Worked out the porch stair and slab cells, the lean-to stair/slab pairs and the shed directions by hand from the plan text, and checked the plan's stairs-facing rule against the library's facing convention.
waste.cost: about 40 cells computed by hand, plus one plan deviation (plot 4 porch) to keep the stairs supported
waste.tool: A porch/shed helper in vocab (porch_shed(g, x0, x1, z, y, wood, high)) that writes the stair row and the slab row from one call.

waste.what: Palette clean-up: the roof tool's default fascia, soffit, verge and texture mixing pulled in blocks outside palette.json (granite, tuff, prismarine, stone slabs), and each fix needed another build.
waste.tool: A roof material option that restricts the auto-mix to the palette's roof role (or a 'palette: true' flag on roof()).

companions.task: The tower's copper pyramid cap (weathered and oxidized cut copper, lightning rod finial) and the lean-to's metal edge, so the copper weathering and the rod are done properly rather than through the tool's auto-mix.
The king-post and queen-post trusses under the gable roofs and the barn gambrel, since roof() was called directly and the trusses option of runParts was not used.
The bread oven's brick vault top and the water tank's conical lid, which belong to my trade but are owned by shell B's helpers, so the two need one agreed owner.

left: roof.json not written: runParts reads one spec for the whole row, so parts/roofs.mjs lays each roof with roof() directly and make.sh prints 'roof: skipped, no roof.json yet'. Reconcile with the other parts or write per-building specs.
No trusses: the roof() calls carry no trusses option, so no king/queen post frame sits under the gable roofs or the barn gambrel.
Oven vault top (plot 6) and tank lid (plot 7 tank) not built here: shell B's bread_oven/water_tank helpers own those cells, and building them here would be refused.

Off-palette roof blocks still present: oak_slab x34 (plot 1 default soffit), stripped_birch_log_stairs x10 (plot 4 verge), tuff_brick_stairs x16, polished_deepslate x5, tuff_bricks x1 (plot 3 slate auto-mix), iron_bars x8 (barn preset bars at (63,11,12) etc.).
157 writes refused into shell-owned air cells (the eave cells at y6 near the plot 0/2 walls): the shell is a stub in this copy, so expect these to clear after merge; recheck the refusal count then.
Overlaps: the plot 2 front dormer and the plot 3 cross gable sit over the main hip, so some of their cells are refused; the dormer's hip and the cross gable were not tuned by eye.
Porch deviation: plot 4 porch stairs are at z10 facing south with slabs at z9 (the plan's z9 north-facing stairs would hang off the back), so the porch shed is supported on the wing.
Pitch 0.75 (plot 2) and 0.5 (plots 6, 7) were passed as numbers; the tool's pitch meaning was not verified by render.

Not run: $MCD check, $MCD fit, render and the LOOK pass (the shell is still stubs in this copy). Plan and elements ticks not made: the roof items are mixed with fittings and walls, so no line could be ticked cleanly.

companions.task: The tower's copper pyramid cap (weathered and oxidized cut copper, lightning rod finial) and the lean-to's metal edge, so the copper weathering and the rod are done properly rather than through the tool's auto-mix.
The king-post and queen-post trusses under the gable roofs and the barn gambrel, since roof() was called directly and the trusses option of runParts was not used.
The bread oven's brick vault top and the water tank's conical lid, which belong to my trade but are owned by shell B's helpers, so the two need one agreed owner.

No trusses: the roof() calls carry no trusses option, so no king/queen post frame sits under the gable roofs or the barn gambrel.
Oven vault top (plot 6) and tank lid (plot 7 tank) not built here: shell B's bread_oven/water_tank helpers own those cells, and building them here would be refused.
